relevance_to_methodology: Supports simple strong controls, ablation-driven complexity, and claim restraint.
notes: Methodological critique.

title: Optimal Detection of Changepoints With a Linear Computational Cost
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
model: Introduces PELT, an exact penalized segmentation algorithm with linear expected cost under stated conditions.
limitations: Offline segmentation gives an estimated statistical change, not physical degradation ground truth.
relevance_to_methodology: Transparent auxiliary onset-sensitivity baseline on engine-level score trajectories.
notes: Onset-estimation method.

title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
model: Maintains a posterior over run length to infer the most recent generative-parameter change online.
limitations: Requires a predictive model and hazard prior; estimated change remains model-dependent.
relevance_to_methodology: Future online onset comparator, not primary evaluation ground truth.
notes: Change-detection method.

title: Selective Review of Offline Change Point Detection Methods
model: Organizes methods by cost function, search, and constraint; links theory to the ruptures implementation.
limitations: A broad review; method selection and calibration remain application-specific.
relevance_to_methodology: Decision guide for any auxiliary change-point onset analysis.
notes: Review paper.

title: Change-Point Detection in Time-Series Data by Relative Density-Ratio Estimation
model: Estimates relative Pearson divergence directly between neighboring windows without separately estimating densities.
limitations: Window and regularization choices affect onset; not a true FD002 label.
relevance_to_methodology: Nonparametric auxiliary onset method for sensitivity checks.
notes: Change-point method.

title: Kernel Change-Point Detection
model: Uses kernel representations and model selection to find distributional changes beyond mean shifts.
limitations: Computational and kernel-selection sensitivity; estimated changes are not physical labels.
relevance_to_methodology: Possible non-linear onset comparator after the primary fixed-proxy analysis.
notes: Change-point method.

title: Control Chart Tests Based on Geometric Moving Averages
model: Foundational exponentially/geometrically weighted moving-average monitoring for small process shifts.
limitations: Classical assumptions do not automatically hold for autocorrelated learned anomaly scores.
relevance_to_methodology: Foundational citation and motivation for EWMA ablation, not proof that EWMA improves FD002.
notes: Foundational method.

title: Continuous Inspection Schemes
model: Introduces cumulative-sum inspection logic for persistent sequential shifts.
limitations: CUSUM requires a declared in-control distribution and tuning for score dependence.
relevance_to_methodology: Comparator to persistence/EWMA if threshold study budget permits.
notes: Foundational method.

title: Learning from Time-Changing Data with Adaptive Windowing
venue: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
model: ADWIN adapts the window length from statistically detected changes rather than a fixed update horizon.
limitations: Blind adaptation can still learn degradation; detector updates need a healthy-state gate.
relevance_to_methodology: Evidence for explicit drift logic if online recalibration is studied later.
notes: Drift method.

title: A Survey on Concept Drift Adaptation
model: Taxonomizes drift detection, adaptation strategies, evaluation, and application settings.
limitations: Concept drift is not identical to irreversible degradation and supervised framing often differs.
relevance_to_methodology: Frames safe adaptation as a separate research problem rather than default threshold updating.
notes: Review paper.

title: Why Should I Trust You?: Explaining the Predictions of Any Classifier
model: Introduces LIME, fitting an interpretable local surrogate around an individual prediction.
limitations: Local surrogate fidelity and perturbation design are crucial, especially for correlated sequences.
relevance_to_methodology: Supports explicit fidelity checks and cautions against relabeling heuristics as explanations.
notes: Explanation method.

title: Axiomatic Attribution for Deep Networks
model: Introduces Integrated Gradients using sensitivity and implementation-invariance axioms.
limitations: Attributions depend on the baseline and explain a scalar model output, not necessarily a causal fault.
relevance_to_methodology: Possible native attribution for the frozen differentiable anomaly score after reconstruction contributions.
notes: Explanation method.

title: Learning Important Features Through Propagating Activation Differences
model: DeepLIFT decomposes output differences from a reference activation into feature contributions.
limitations: Reference choice and network operation rules affect interpretation.
relevance_to_methodology: Secondary native-gradient-style explainer if a scalar score explanation is needed.
notes: Explanation method.

title: TimeSHAP: Explaining Recurrent Models through Sequence Perturbations
model: Extends KernelSHAP to feature-, event-, and cell-level attributions with sequence pruning.
limitations: Computational cost, perturbation realism, and correlated sensor-time inputs can weaken fidelity.
relevance_to_methodology: Most relevant optional SHAP-family method for an LSTM, after native contribution maps are validated.
notes: Explanation method.

title: Explaining Anomalies Detected by Autoencoders Using SHAP
learning_setting: unsupervised or method-dependent; exact training supervision NR
model: Uses KernelSHAP around an autoencoder anomaly score to show features increasing or offsetting anomalousness.
limitations: Perturbations and surrogate fidelity must be validated; explanations are not root-cause proof.
relevance_to_methodology: Direct precedent for optional AE-SHAP after removing the current placeholder payload.
notes: Explanation method.

title: Feature Bagging for Outlier Detection
model: Combines outlier detectors trained on random feature subsets to improve robustness in noisy high dimensions.
limitations: Random sensor subsets may destroy important temporal/physical dependencies.
relevance_to_methodology: Historical ensemble precedent; supports ablation before assuming fusion helps.
notes: Different datasets and representations.

title: LSCP: Locally Selective Combination in Parallel Outlier Ensembles
venue: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
model: Selects locally competent base outlier detectors before combining their scores.
limitations: Competence estimation without ground truth adds complexity and possible overfitting.
relevance_to_methodology: Evidence that fusion is a model-selection problem, not a free performance gain.
notes: Different data and selection protocol.

title: SUOD: Accelerating Large-Scale Unsupervised Heterogeneous Outlier Detection
model: Accelerates many heterogeneous detectors using data reduction, model approximation, and balanced scheduling.
limitations: An acceleration system does not establish that an ensemble improves scientific validity.
relevance_to_methodology: Scaling option only if many detector variants are later justified.
notes: Different goal and datasets.

title: Interpreting and Unifying Outlier Scores
venue: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
model: Maps heterogeneous arbitrary outlier factors to a common interpretable range before comparison or combination.
limitations: Probability-like normalization is model-based and not guaranteed to be calibrated probability.
relevance_to_methodology: Direct support for frozen training-fitted score calibration before any fusion.
notes: Score-transformation method.

title: Explainable Deep One-Class Classification
model: FCDD makes a fully convolutional one-class output map serve directly as an anomaly explanation map.
limitations: Image-specific architecture; not directly applicable to 30-by-21 sensor sequences.
relevance_to_methodology: Evidence that explanation can be native to the detector rather than a mislabeled post-hoc heuristic.
notes: Different modality.

title: On the Evaluation of Unsupervised Outlier Detection: Measures, Datasets, and an Empirical Study
model: Studies evaluation measures, benchmark construction, contamination, and instability across many outlier detectors.
limitations: Mostly tabular outlier settings; temporal grouping and early warning require additional metrics.
relevance_to_methodology: Supports careful benchmark construction and multiple strong classical controls.
notes: Different datasets and evaluation units.
